responsibility: This implementation file provides shared runtime support for GCC’s generic hash_table template. It owns the prime-size table used for sizing and expansion, the hash-table statistics descriptor and reporting entry point, the global checking limit for hash/equality sanitation, the helper that chooses the next table size, and the common diagnostic emitted when trait equality is inconsistent with the hash function.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the non-template shared support for the hash-table subsystem—prime sizing tables, next-prime lookup, statistics/reporting helpers, the sanitize limit, and the common hash/equality failure diagnostic—whereas gcc/hash-table.h implements the templated container itself.
